_comment: Settings for tools/update-characters.mjs. WoW: Forever (since the launch, 5 Nov 2026): namespace profile-forever-<region>, no realm: characters are looked up as /profile/wow/character/<first>-<surname> (nameFormat "realmless"; public profiles exist from level 10). For regular (retail) WoW use namespace profile-eu, a realm slug and nameFormat "encode". Other name formats for realm-based versions: hyphen | nospace.
